item.title: ITC Infotech Launches Digital and AI Engineering Hub
item.description: ITC Infotech inaugurated its Digital & AI Engineering Hub in Riyadh, as the company completes 15 years of operations in the Middle East.

item.title: Comera Pay Launches Merchant Acquiring Payment Solutions

item.title: Hyde Park Developments Launches Hyde Park Terraces
item.description: Hyde Park Developments has launched Hyde Park Terraces, spanning 102 acres, the project is located in the heart of New Cairo.

item.title: Revolutionizing the Road: The Future of Automotive Service Innovation in the Middle East 2025
item.description: Petromin Corporation has proved that with an experienced management team and a dedicated workforce, it is possible to achieve the impossible when it comes to sustainability. With Vision 2030 firmly in view, the company firmly believes its approach will bring a positive impact on the global climate.
